title: Recursive Integrity Toolkit Schema Mapping Skeleton
description: Phase 1 structural contract for declarative field mapping. It does not authorize arbitrary code, imports, shell commands, filesystem access, environment access, or network access.

mapping_version.description: Version of the mapping document format.

mappingSection.description: Declarative mappings for one input role.

fieldMapping.description: Source, constant, and allowlisted operation declarations for one canonical field.

operation.description: One declarative operation. Operation-specific validation is deferred to Phase 2.

op.description: Approved operation name such as rename, trim, cast, parse, coalesce, map, or case normalization.
